title: Registered focused run refused at capture_registration ("test run source owner configuration changed before publication") when the launching turn ends before TRACKED
outcome: A registered focused run whose launching turn ends while registration is still in flight is either admitted, or refused with a message that names the turn boundary as the cause and tells the agent to keep the turn open until TRACKED, instead of the misleading "configuration changed" text.
acceptance: Registered focused run refused at capture_registration ("test run source owner configuration changed before publication") when the launching turn ends before TRACKED is done
